Xbox Hub private-source build validation trigger
Request: validate the latest private main after hardening the offline manifest signer
Source version: 0.1.7-preview.1
Source commit: 36019d8bbc6889e93753f768bb2d80881fb631f9
Scope: Windows x64 restore, self-contained app/updater publish, exact two-file package validation, updater transaction tests, and PowerShell parser-only checks of both offline signing helpers.
Security: helpers are not executed; no key is generated or used. No private source, packages, artifacts, signing keys, TLS keys, Cloudflare tokens, or credentials are uploaded.
